verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents its own ordered V4 run-event stream (`runs.events()`), which can be polled to monitor a run or build a custom UI. That approximates a step-by-step action timeline, but the evidence never describes recorded replays, video, or screenshots. The documented live preview is real-time human control, not a recorded replay, so it is not credited. missing for 10: session video recordings, per-step screenshots, an explicit post-hoc replay or debugging view for failed runs, evidence that events are retained for after-the-fact inspection, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can debug a failed agent run from recorded replays — video, screenshots, step-by-step action timelines

citations.quote: Poll ordered V4 events to monitor a run or build a custom UI.
Poll `runs.events()` with the previous cursor to receive only new events
